This release prepares ASFFreeGames installations on ASF 6 for the ASF 7 upgrade. Install it while ASF 6 is running and restart ASF before upgrading the host. The startup log should show ASFFreeGamesPlugin 1.10.2.0 or later.

The updater now chooses the archive for the target ASF major. This release has one V6 ZIP so older plugin installations can discover it safely. Manual installers on ASF 6 can extract ASFFreeGames-generic.zip into plugins/ASFFreeGames/.
